title: SM64DS Co-op menu preview.3 — Original DS Staff Roll and gameplay options
notes:
Staff Roll now runs the original 20 DS course-panorama scripts, with their camera paths, scene timing and fades. It loops before the ending cast scene and hides Mario, other players, shadows and HUD only in this background. Selected menu music continues independently.

The other seven built-in backgrounds show Mario facing a fixed camera. They use CoopDX's reference course locations adapted to DS collision and camera placement; Dire Dire Docks uses its DS entrance point because CoopDX has no menu preset for that course.

New gameplay options:
- **Options > Player > Movement Mod > SM64:** optional Mario-only N64 walking and jump constants. This is a beta profile; DS air steering, slopes, collision and action transitions remain.
- **Options > Camera > SM64 Cam:** Lakitu-style 45-degree turns, two zoom distances, pan and DS collision handling. Q/E or gamepad bumpers turn; R/F zoom; C recenters. N64 level-specific camera volumes and alternate modes are not reproduced.
- **Options > Display > Object Distance:** DS Default, Near, Medium, Far or Unlimited drawing distance. Object simulation and native area visibility remain.

The integrated menu retains three adventure-save previews, 33 full-length DS themes, menu effects, custom MP3/FLAC/WAV music, shuffle choices and custom PNG/JPEG/BMP backgrounds.

**Windows x86 preview:** open `sm64ds coop.exe` directly. Replace the EXE in an existing installation and retain assets, settings, saves and custom media. No BAT launcher or decoder DLL is needed. The 3,448,610-byte ZIP contains only the 9,948,672-byte EXE, README and license notices; supply your own supported game data. No ROM, Nintendo assets, songs or saves are included.

Validation on source `24827fd0d0a71b7b66fc9fc91fc6a4812c6ae26f`: full native build and all three DS-state/face-cycle/ARM9-global guards passed. All 21 isolated runtime checks passed: menu pages across all eight backgrounds, all 20 native Staff Roll cameras and the loop wrap, Mario's rendered facing direction, scenery transitions, audio/custom media, gameplay movement/jumps/long jump, camera turns/zoom, near/unlimited object drawing and unchanged Luigi movement. Captures of all backgrounds and credits scenes were inspected. All nine portable component and Windows-host CI jobs passed: https://github.com/SCOPIC64/sm64ds-coop-port/actions/runs/38054341820

Native Linux/SteamOS, macOS, Android and iOS game builds are still unfinished. Android/iOS SDK component checks are not APK/IPA releases or on-device touchscreen validation. This remains a prerelease: fresh-folder import, adventure save-loading, two-client co-op and return-to-menu need further runtime testing. Existing repository dead-reference and missing-private-assets CI failures remain documented in PR #5.
